name: arch-gp-demo
notes: Single-page Vite/React demo (src/App.tsx, DEPLOYMENT.md) that a visitor scrolls: a worked machining drawing with clickable extracted fields, a linked graph, a QR path and a maintenance-loop explainer, all on fixed illustrative data. Archetype is reader (published, read-and-poke content), not visualization: the graph is a fixed illustration, not an explorer over user data. stakes=prototype overrides the content-site default because it is a pitch demo with illustrative data, not a relied-on site. data=none: no backend, no storage, no user data. ai=none: the maintenance loop is described, not run in the app. No sign-in.
